description: This is a Java entity class representing a user role in a book tracking application. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction, and includes custom annotation exclusions for code coverage tools. It defines a Role entity with an auto-generated ID and a role name, along with standard equals and hashCode methods.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing a user role, with generated ID and role name, including custom equals and hashCode implementations. Uses Lombok to generate getters, setters, and constructors.

methods.name: Role
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Role with a role name, marked with @NonNull to prevent null assignment.

methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare Role objects based on the role name field.

methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() to compute hash based on the role name.
